title: ¶ On. S. katheryns daye The Epiſtle.

segments.text: LOrde / I dyd lyfte vp my prayer vpon the erth / and beſought to be delyuered from death. I called vpon the lorde ye father of my lorde / that he ſhuld not leaue me helpleſſe in the daye of my trybulacion / and in the daye of the proude man. I prayſed thy name perpetually / and honoured it with confeſſion / and my prayer was harde. And thou ſauedeſt me that I periſſhed not / and delyueredeſt me oute of the tyme of vnryghteouſnes. Therfore will I confeſſe and prayſe the / and will bleſſe the name of the Lorde
